description: One-way, round-trip and multi-city Google Flights itineraries with fares, legs, carbon emissions and price history, as structured JSON. Runs on HasData's hosted API.

x-api-key.description: Enter your API key from the HasData dashboard.

tool_signatures.name: hasdata_google_travel_flights_getGoogleFlights
tool_signatures.description:
Get Google Flights Results

Searches Google Flights for one-way, round-trip, or multi-city itineraries with passenger mix (adults, children, infants in-seat/on-lap), travel class, bags, max price, sort order (price, duration, emissions, departure/arrival time), stops, include/exclude airlines and connections, time windows, layover duration, and deep-search mode. Returns per-itinerary price, total duration, stops, flight legs with airline, flight number, aircraft, departure/arrival airports and times, CO2 emissions, plus booking and departure tokens for round-trip returns or booking options. Use for travel-planning agents, fare monitoring, corporate travel dashboards, emission-aware trip optimization, and comparing routes and airlines across markets.

gl.description: The two-letter country code for the country you want to limit the search to. Provide one exact documented value (245 allowed), e.g. `ac`, `af`.

hl.description: The two-letter language code for the language you want to use for the search. Provide one exact documented value (159 allowed), e.g. `af`, `ak`.

bags.description: Number of carry-on bags per passenger.

type.description:
Specifies the type of flight. Options:

  - `roundTrip` (default)
  - `oneWay`
  - `multiCity` (requires `multiCityJson` for flight details)

For round trips, retrieve return flight details with a separate request using `departureToken`.

stops.description: Restrict the number of stops (layovers) in the flight itinerary.

adults.description: Number of adult passengers (>= 1 if specified).

sortBy.description: Sort the flight results based on price, departure time, arrival time, etc.

currency.description: Parameter defines the currency of the returned prices Provide one exact documented value (71 allowed), e.g. `ALL`, `DZD`.

maxPrice.description: Maximum price limit for the flight search, in the selected currency.

arrivalId.description:
Specifies the arrival airport code (IATA) or location kgmid.

  - **IATA Code**: A 3-letter uppercase code (e.g., `SFO` for San Francisco, `LHR` for London Heathrow). Search on [IATA](https://www.iata.org/en/publications/directories/code-search).
  - **Location kgmid**: A string starting with `/m/`, found in Wikidata under "Freebase ID" (e.g., `/m/02_286` for New York, NY).

Multiple values can be separated by commas (e.g., `JFK,LGA,/m/0hptm`).

deepSearch.description: Enable deep search. Returns the same results as Google Flights in a browser, but takes longer to respond. Default is `false`.

returnDate.description: The return travel date in 'yyyy-MM-dd' format. Required when **type** is `roundTrip`.

showHidden.description: Indicates whether to include hidden options in the results.

departureId.description:
Specifies the departure airport code (IATA) or location kgmid.

  - **IATA Code**: A 3-letter uppercase code (e.g., SFO for San Francisco, LHR for London Heathrow). Search on [IATA](https://www.iata.org/en/publications/directories/code-search).
  - **Location kgmid**: A string starting with `/m/`, found in Wikidata under "Freebase ID" (e.g., `/m/02_286` for New York, NY).

Multiple values can be separated by commas (e.g., `JFK,LGA,/m/0hptm`).

maxDuration.description: The maximum total flight duration in minutes.

returnTimes.description:
Set up to 4 time boundaries (2 for departure, 2 for arrival) to filter return flights. Each number represents the start of an hour.

Examples:
  - `6,20` → 6:00 AM - 9:00 PM departure
  - `1,15` → 1:00 AM - 4:00 PM departure
  - `7,18,2,21` → 7:00 AM - 9:00 PM departure, 2:00 AM - 10:00 PM arrival

travelClass.description: The travel class for the flight (Economy, Premium Economy, Business, or First).

bookingToken.description: Used to request booking options for selected flights. This token is found in the flight results and cannot be used with `departureToken`.

infantsOnLap.description: Number of infants sitting on an adult's lap.

outboundDate.description: The outbound travel date in 'yyyy-MM-dd' format.

lessEmissions.description: Prefer flight options with lower carbon emissions.

multiCityJson.description:
This parameter specifies flight details for multi-city trips. It is a JSON string containing multiple flight objects. Each object must include the following fields:

- **departureId** – The departure airport code or location KGMID. Uses the same format as the main `departureId` parameter.
- **arrivalId** – The arrival airport code or location KGMID. Uses the same format as the main `arrivalId` parameter.
- **date** – The flight date. Uses the same format as the `outboundDate` parameter.
- **times** *(optional)* – The time range for the flight. Uses the same format as the `outboundTimes` parameter.

outboundTimes.description:
Set up to 4 time boundaries (2 for departure, 2 for arrival) to filter flights. Each number represents the start of an hour.

Examples:
  - `6,20` → 6:00 AM - 9:00 PM departure
  - `1,15` → 1:00 AM - 4:00 PM departure
  - `7,18,2,21` → 7:00 AM - 9:00 PM departure, 2:00 AM - 10:00 PM arrival

departureToken.description: Used to select a flight and retrieve return flights for a round trip or the next leg of the itinerary for a multi-city trip.

excludeAirlines.description: A comma separated list of airline codes to exclude from results. You can search for airline codes on [IATA](https://www.iata.org/en/publications/directories/code-search). For example, `UA` is United Airlines.

includeAirlines.description:
A comma separated list of airline codes to exclusively include in results. You can search for airline codes on [IATA](https://www.iata.org/en/publications/directories/code-search). For example, `UA` is United Airlines.

`excludeAirlines` and `includeAirlines` parameters can't be used together.

layoverDuration.description: Set the maximum layover duration in minutes to filter flights. For example, `120, 360` filters layovers between 2 hours and 6 hours, while `45, 180` allows layovers from 45 minutes to 3 hours.

excludeConnections.description: A comma separated list of specific airports to exclude as connections.

includeConnections.description: A comma separated list of specific airports to allow as connections.
